notes: No WebGL renderer was used: FPS, actual draw calls and GPU upload time remain unverified.
Static batches keep hidden logical sources for audit: scene mesh/polygon totals include them and are not rendered mesh/polygon counts.
Geometry variants trade bounded extra heap for avoided repeated CSG/buffer allocation.
Process CPU can exceed wall time because helper threads and GC are included.
First-time ABC state generation still has spikes; repeated states are cached, not claimed to be universally hitch-free.
